claims.text: Nayzilam (midazolam nasal spray): acute seizure clusters, ≥12 yrs.
claims.quote: seizure activity (i.e., seizure clusters, acute repetitive seizures) that are distinct from a patient's usual seizure pattern in patients with epilepsy 12 years of age and older
that are distinct from a patient's usual seizure pattern in patients with epilepsy 2 years of age and older
that are distinct from a patient's usual seizure pattern in patients with epilepsy 2 to 5 years of age
